entities.name: PMID:27505217
observations: Randomized study of 176 student and community adults tested implicit high- versus low-level construal and ad-libitum energy-dense snack intake.
High construal reduced snack intake versus low construal when an implicit visual cue-reminder was present (p = .02), but not when absent (p = .40).

entities.name: Cue-dependent snack reduction
observations: An implicit high-level construal manipulation reduced actual energy-dense snack intake only when the visual cue-reminder was present; without the reminder, the between-condition difference was nonsignificant.
